items.name: Yamaha x Korg x Ketron x Dream Sam (JC)

notes: SingTonado 1.9.1 adds three optional sound banks: KaraOke King v2, Platinum 3.1 (Arkyn), and Yamaha x Korg x Ketron x Dream Sam (JC).
Removes the four-bank truncation from the downloaded sound selector so all available banks remain selectable.
Update the app, open DOWNLOAD SONGS once to refresh the catalogue, then Settings → Sound → Download beside the desired bank. Select it after its download finishes.
The three files are optional downloads of about 99 MB, 141 MB and 949 MB; the catalogue now contains 11 sound banks.
All three banks passed SoundFont structure checks and native desktop FluidSynth playback renders. Phone playback has not been device-tested.
Library refresh: two new lyric-bearing songs; permanent SingTonado numbers are unchanged for existing songs. Open DOWNLOAD SONGS to get them.
